slides.texte_overlay:
things people with ADHD do
that look weird
(but make total sense)

1. rereading a message
5 times before sending it

you're hunting for the mistake
you're sure your brain made

2. needing a podcast on
to clean the house

the noise keeps the restless part
of your brain busy
so the rest can get to work

3. leaving 10 minutes early
and still arriving late

time doesn't feel like a straight line.
"10 minutes" could be 2 or 40

4. starting with
"sorry, random but…"

your brain already took 4 steps
to get there. everyone else
just didn't see them

5. fidgeting with anything
within reach

a little movement in your hands
helps your mind
stay in the room

6. keeping everything
out on the desk

if you can't see it,
it basically stops existing
